structured.condensed: Determines fee codes and attributes for a business filing based on filing type, legal entity type, and flags. Extracts priority, fee waiver, and filing name from the input JSON; retrieves legal type from the name request (for new business filings) or business record. Branches on filing type: correction filings append the correction code; voluntary dissolution appends dissolution code plus special resolution and affidavit codes for cooperatives, and checks futureEffective; administrative dissolution appends hardcoded 'NOFEE'; courtOrder, registrarsNotation, registrarsOrder, putBackOn, and adminFreeze each append their single code. All other filings iterate through filing keys, optionally applying a subtype lookup, and for changeOfDirectors, determine if free based on whether all director actions are only nameChanged or addressChanged, selecting the free or standard code accordingly; suppress priority flag for changeOfDirectors and changeOfAddress except when parent filing is not annualReport; append futureEffective for incorporation, amalgamation, continuationIn, and alteration. Returns list of filing type objects with filingTypeCode, priority, waiveFees, and optionally futureEffective or filingDescription. GOTCHA: no checks validate that filing_json contains expected keys before access, risking KeyError; no validation that returned filing_type_code exists or is non-null before appending.

Flask HTTP resource for payment request and invoice endpoints: GET, POST, DELETE, PATCH and PDF report generation.

Entry points: GET /payment-requests (requires Role.SYSTEM) queries InvoiceService.find_invoices(businessIdentifier query param); POST /payment-requests (requires auth) validates request against 'payment_request' schema, checks auth with check_auth(businessIdentifier, corpType from request, contains_role=MAKE_PAYMENT), then calls PaymentService.create_invoice(request_json, authorization); GET /payment-requests/{invoice_id} (requires auth) calls InvoiceService.find_by_id(invoice_id).asdict(include_dynamic_fields=True); DELETE /payment-requests/{invoice_id} (requires auth) calls PaymentService.accept_delete(invoice_id) and returns 202 Accepted; PATCH /payment-requests/{invoice_id} (requires auth) validates request against 'payment_info' schema, reads applyCredit query param ('false' default), calls PaymentService.update_invoice(invoice_id, request_json, is_apply_credit); POST /payment-requests/{invoice_id}/reports (requires auth) calls InvoiceService.create_invoice_pdf(invoice_id), returns PDF with Content-Disposition attachment header.

Validation errors (format or schema) return Error.INVALID_REQUEST with serialized errors. BusinessException and ServiceUnavailableException caught and returned via exception.response(). All endpoints decorated with @cross_origin. GET /payment-requests logs <get_invoices and >get_invoices; others log entry/exit with context. POST /payment-requests logs full request_json. PATCH logs invoice_id and request_json. DELETE logs <delete_invoice and >delete_invoice. All return jsonify(response) and status code.

GOTCHA: GET /payment-requests checks Role.SYSTEM but POST, GET/{id}, DELETE, PATCH all use requires_auth with no role check—permission enforcement relies on check_auth for POST only; other endpoints show no check.

structured.condensed: Flask REST endpoint that calculates filing fees for a business entity based on corporate and filing type. Entry point: GET /{corp_type}/{filing_type_code} callable only by roles VIEWER, EDITOR, or STAFF (checked via @_jwt.has_one_of_roles). Accepts query parameters: date (defaults to now in DT_SHORT_FORMAT), priority (boolean, default False), futureEffective (boolean, default False), jurisdiction (default DEFAULT_JURISDICTION), quantity (integer, default 1), and waiveFees (boolean, default False, only accessible when caller has STAFF role, checked via _jwt.validate_roles). On BusinessException, returns exception.response(). Initializes an annual report filing form for a business entity and manages changes to it; a Vue component lifecycle method that handles the assembly of the form with original data and handles subsequent user modifications.

Entry point: `mounted()` — entry point on component initialization with no check shown; validates required tombstone data (getIdentifier, ARFilingYear, filingId) and entity-specific dates (arMinDate/arMaxDate for coops, nextARDate for base companies), redirecting to dashboard if missing. If filingId > 0, calls `fetchDraftFiling()` to resume a draft; otherwise fetches original office addresses and directors. Sets up change handlers for office addresses, directors (paid and free change codes), and AGM date validity; for base companies, immediately adds ANNUAL_REPORT_BC filing code using existing Priority and Waive Fees flags.

`fetchDraftFiling()` — called on resume; fetches filing via LegalServices at path `businesses/{getIdentifier}/filings/{filingId}`, verifies header (type ANNUAL_REPORT, status DRAFT), business identifier and legal name match, then restores certifiedBy, staff payment data (routes: FAS/BCOL/NO_FEE/NONE), AGM date, AGM extension flag, and optional change-of-directors and change-of-address sections; throws errors for missing or mismatched data; logs errors and shows resumeErrorDialog on failure with no retry.

Event handlers (`officeModifiedEventHandler`, `directorsPaidChange`, `directorsFreeChange`, `onAgmDateChange`, `onAgmExtensionChange`, `onNoAgmChange`, `onAgmDateValidChange`) — called by child components; update filing data (add or remove filing codes ADDRESS_CHANGE_OT, DIRECTOR_CHANGE_OT, FREE_DIRECTOR_CHANGE_OT, ANNUAL_REPORT_OT) and set haveChanges flag once dataLoaded is true.

`onClickSave()` — called when user clicks Save; prevents double-save via busySaving flag, calls `saveFiling(true)`, catches errors and assigns SaveErrorReasons.SAVE.

GOTCHA: No checks shown on mounted() entry point. Change-of-directors and change-of-address restoration from draft throws errors only if present but structurally invalid; if absent, silently leaves existing data intact.

This module contains the worker that processes business filing messages from NATS Streaming; the entry point is cb_subscription_handler (not shown in this chunk).

**Inputs:** Filing message from NATS queue containing filing_json with filing type keys.

**Outputs:** Publishing to NATS (async publish_event) and GCP Queue (publish_gcp_queue_event), and optional email to MRAS via publish_email_message.

**get_filing_types** extracts keys from legal_filings['filing'] where Filing.FILINGS holds a value; returns list of filing type strings.

**publish_event (async):** Publishes a CloudEvent to qsm.service on subject from ENTITY_EVENT_PUBLISH_OPTIONS['subject']. Payload includes specversion '1.x-wip', type 'bc.registry.business.{filing_type}', source (LEGAL_API_URL/business/{identifier}/filing/{id}), filing header with filingId and effectiveDate, business identifier, and legalFilings list. Adds tempidentifier if filing.temp_reg exists. This chunk shows no check who may call it. On any exception: captured to Sentry with filing.id, logged at error level, exception swallowed (not re-raised).

**publish_gcp_queue_event:** Publishes a SimpleCloudEvent to gcp_queue on subject from BUSINESS_EVENTS_TOPIC, with identical data structure and source as NATS version. On any exception: captured to Sentry with filing.id, logged at error level, exception swallowed.

**publish_mras_email (async):** If filing.filing_type is AMALGAMATIONAPPLICATION, CONTINUATIONIN, or INCORPORATIONAPPLICATION, publishes email message via publish_email_message to qsm on EMAIL_PUBLISH_OPTIONS['subject'] with subject 'mras'. On exception: captured to Sentry with filing.id and error, exception swallowed.

GOTCHA: All exceptions in publish_event, publish_gcp_queue_event, and publish_mras_email are caught and only logged/captured to Sentry; failures do not fail the filing or retry. GOTCHA: publish_mras_email only checks three specific filing types; other filing types silently skip email publication with no guard or log.

structured.condensed: Documentation of FAS-to-CFS API integration points for payment processing. When a routing slip is created, FAS calls CFS endpoints `/parties`, `/accs`, `/sites`, and `/rcpts` to set up a customer entity, account named BCR, a site (with hard-coded values due to no address provided), and a receipt numbered from the routing slip. On invoice creation, FAS calls `/invs` to create an invoice against the site, then `/rcpts/apply` to apply the receipt. On full invoice cancellation, FAS calls `/rcpts/unapply` then `/invs/adjs` to zero the invoice. On partial cancellation, FAS unapplies, adjusts to partial amount, then reapplies. For refund approval, FAS calls `/rcpts/adjs` with an activity_name to move funds to refund revenue. For write-offs under $10, FAS calls `/rcpts/adjs` with activity_name to move to write-off revenue. When a cheque bounces, FAS calls `/rcpts/reverse` to unapply all invoices, then `/invs` to create an NSF fee invoice. When linking routing slips, FAS reverses the child receipt and creates a new receipt on the parent. GOTCHA: endpoints `/rcpts/adjs` and `/rcpts/reverse` are marked with question marks indicating uncertainty. GOTCHA: site creation uses hard-coded values due to missing address data. No permission checks, credentials, payload shapes, error handling, or retry logic documented.

Documentation on deploying authentication API and web UI components to OpenShift, including database setup, build configuration, and pipeline creation.

**Setup and Configuration:**
Objects use labels (app, app-group, template) for selection; commands query or delete by label. Secrets and configmaps must not be embedded in templates; they are created separately with literal values (username, password) via `oc create secret` and applied with `--dry-run -o json | oc apply -f -`. Existing secrets are extended via `jq` merge.

**API Deployment Flow:**
Login to OpenShift, switch to dev namespace (1rdehl-dev), deploy PostgreSQL from `postgresql-deploy.json` with TAG_NAME=dev, then manually create a tester superuser role in the postgres pod. Process `auth-api-pre-deploy.json` to create configmap and secrets (requires manual value replacement after). Process `auth-api-deploy.json` with NAME=auth-api, TAG_NAME=dev, REPLICAS=1, and JAEGER_COLLECTOR=--collector.host-port=jaeger-collector.d7eovc-dev.svc:14267 to create DeployConfig, Service, and Route.

**API Build Flow:**
Switch to tools namespace (1rdehl-tools). Process `auth-api-build.json` with NAME=auth-api, GIT_REPO_URL=https://github.com/bcgov/sbc-auth.git, GIT_REF=development. Process `auth-api-pipeline.json` with those parameters plus TAG_NAME=dev, WEBHOOK=github-auth-api-dev, and JENKINS_FILE=./jenkins/dev.groovy.

**Web Deployment Flow:**
In dev namespace, process `auth-web-pre-deploy.json` with NAME=auth-web, TAG_NAME=dev (manual secret replacement). Process `auth-web-deploy.json` with NAME=auth-web, NAME_RUNTIME=auth-web-runtime, TAG_NAME=dev, REPLICAS=1.

**Web Build Flow:**
In tools namespace, process `auth-web-build.json` with NAME=auth-web, GIT_REPO_URL=https://github.com/bcgov/sbc-auth.git, GIT_REF=development. Run `oc new-build --name auth-web-runtime --binary --strategy docker`, then process `auth-web-runtime-build.json` with NAME=auth-web-runtime. Process `auth-web-pipeline.json` with NAME=auth-web, TAG_NAME=dev, GIT_REPO_URL, GIT_REF=development, WEBHOOK=github-auth-web-dev, JENKINS_FILE=./jenkins/dev.groovy.

No entry points, permission checks, or outbound calls shown. GOTCHA: Secret values must be manually replaced after template processing; no automation documented. GOTCHA: PostgreSQL tester user created via manual psql terminal; not automated.

OpenShift configuration template that establishes RBAC rules for GitHub CI/CD credentials management. 

Defines a Role with verbs (get, list, create, delete, patch, update) on configmaps and secrets across all apiGroups; (get, list, patch, update, watch) on deploymentconfigs and deploymentconfigs/scale in empty and apps.openshift.io apiGroups; (get, list, watch) on deploymentconfigs/log and deploymentconfigs/status. Creates a RoleBinding that binds this Role to a ServiceAccount named ${NAME} in namespace ${NAMESPACE_TOOLS}, granting the account permissions to manage credentials and deployment configurations in ${NAMESPACE}.

Takes three parameters: NAMESPACE (required, defaults to cc892f-dev) where roles are stored; NAMESPACE_TOOLS (required, defaults to d893f6-tools) where credential components live; NAME (required, defaults to github-cicd) used for all components. No entry points or runtime decisions; purely declarative configuration.

Creates an invoice for a business filing submission by calling the payment service and saves the payment token to the filing. Entry point: static method called by others; this chunk shows no check. Input: Business and Filing objects, filing types list, JWT manager, optional payment account ID. Output: tuple of payment token ID (or None), error dict (or None), and HTTP status code. Flow: determines office type and mailing address based on filing type (new business, conversion, or other), extracts or derives corporate type and business name, builds payload with business info, filing info, details, and optional folio number; if user has staff or system role, adds account info from routing slip/BCOL/DAT numbers to payload; posts payload to payment service with bearer token auth (20 second timeout); on success saves payment token, status code, and account to filing and returns isPaymentActionRequired flag; on BAD_REQUEST saves error type to payment_status_code and returns error details; other failures return generic error. Save point: filing persisted after payment service succeeds or on BAD_REQUEST error. GOTCHA: connection errors only logged, not retried or re-raised. GOTCHA: no duplicate guard on invoice creation. GOTCHA: special_role saved to filing but never validated to match caller's actual permissions.
